en: Sari looks out of her window at night. The sky is dark. Where is the Moon? She cannot see it, but the stars twinkle.
Two evenings later, Sari sees a thin silver curve low in the sky, like a fingernail. 'There you are, Moon!'
A few nights later, the curve is bigger, like a big smile in the sky.
A few more nights, and Sari sees half a Moon, like half a cookie.
Night by night, the Moon grows rounder, until a round, bright Moon seems to look back at her. Sari waves. 'Hello, round Moon!'
id: Sari melihat ke luar jendela pada malam hari. Langitnya gelap. Di mana Bulan? Sari tidak bisa melihatnya, tetapi bintang-bintang berkelip.
Dua hari kemudian, saat senja, Sari melihat lengkungan perak yang tipis di langit rendah, seperti kuku jari. 'Itu kamu, Bulan!'
Beberapa malam kemudian, lengkungannya makin besar, seperti senyum lebar di langit.
Beberapa malam lagi, Sari melihat setengah Bulan, seperti setengah kue.
Malam demi malam, Bulan makin bulat, sampai Bulan yang bulat dan terang seolah ikut menatapnya. Sari melambai. 'Halo, Bulan bulat!'

readAloudNotes.en: Cover your eyes and pretend to search, then open and close your fingers like twinkling stars.
readAloudNotes.id: Tutup mata dan pura-pura mencari, lalu buka-tutup jari seperti bintang berkelip.

readAloudNotes.en: Show your child your thumbnail and compare it to the thin Moon.
readAloudNotes.id: Tunjukkan kuku ibu jari kepada anak dan bandingkan dengan Bulan yang tipis.

readAloudNotes.en: Draw a big smile shape in the air with your finger.
readAloudNotes.id: Gambar bentuk senyum lebar di udara dengan jari.

readAloudNotes.en: Make half a circle with one curved hand, or break a pretend cookie in two.
readAloudNotes.id: Buat setengah lingkaran dengan satu tangan yang melengkung, atau pura-pura mematahkan kue jadi dua.

readAloudNotes.en: Make a big circle with both arms and wave hello.
readAloudNotes.id: Buat lingkaran besar dengan kedua lengan dan lambaikan tangan.

objectives.en: Listens to a story about how the evening Moon seems to grow over many nights.
objectives.id: Mendengarkan cerita tentang Bulan senja yang tampak membesar selama banyak malam.

objectives.en: Uses shape words: thin, curve, half, round.
objectives.id: Menggunakan kata bentuk: tipis, lengkung, setengah, bulat.

meaning.en: shaped like a circle or a ball
a line that bends, like a smile

meaning.id: satu dari dua bagian yang sama

meaning.en: to shine on and off a little

prompt.en: What could Sari see when there was no Moon?
prompt.id: Apa yang bisa Sari lihat saat tidak ada Bulan?

prompt.en: What did the Moon look like after the thin curve?
prompt.id: Seperti apa Bulan setelah lengkungan tipis?

en: a bigger curve, like a smile

prompt.en: On the dark night, had the Moon really gone away?
prompt.id: Pada malam yang gelap itu, apakah Bulan benar-benar pergi?

en: no, it was still there and came back
yes, it was gone for ever
id: tidak, Bulan tetap ada dan terlihat lagi

prompt.en: What shape was the Moon at the end?
prompt.id: Bagaimana bentuk Bulan di akhir cerita?

connection.en: After the new moon, the evening Moon looks a little bigger each night until it is full; the pattern repeats about every month.
connection.id: Setelah bulan baru, Bulan senja tampak sedikit lebih besar setiap malam sampai purnama; polanya berulang kira-kira setiap bulan.

discussionPrompts.en: What shape is the Moon tonight?
discussionPrompts.id: Bentuk Bulan malam ini seperti apa?

discussionPrompts.en: What else do you see in the night sky?
discussionPrompts.id: Apa lagi yang kamu lihat di langit malam?

offlineActivity.en: Start on the evening after a new moon (check a calendar). For a week, look at the evening sky together just after sunset and draw the Moon's shape on a paper calendar each night.
offlineActivity.id: Mulailah pada sore hari setelah bulan baru (lihat kalender). Selama seminggu, lihat langit senja bersama tepat setelah matahari terbenam dan gambar bentuk Bulan di kalender kertas setiap malam.

factChecks.claim: The Moon appears to change shape over about a month and then the cycle repeats.
Around the new moon the Moon cannot be seen; a day or two later a thin crescent appears in the evening sky after sunset.
In the evenings after the new moon, the Moon grows from crescent to half to full over about two weeks.
